title: Trivia Escape Rooms
specs: Rooms fuse trivia questions with escape puzzles
Rooms are open, bright, and first door unlocked for safety
At least one player should be familiar with the theme for trivia-heavy rooms
Players under 5 years old do not need to pay
Doggy Escape Room allows up to 2 dogs, dogs play free

includes: Take home canvas and full round of paint (Wet Paint Escape)

blurb: Participants are locked in a themed room and must solve puzzles and trivia to escape or find a missing item within a set time. Rooms are designed to be open and bright with the first door unlocked for easy exit. Game time is usually 60 minutes, with some themes shorter at 45 minutes.
extraNote: Full refund of deposit with minimum 72 hours notice · No refund within 72 hours except for weather or urgent emergencies; exchange offered · Rooms are never locked; guests can exit anytime · 1615 Dupont St., Ground Flr Toronto, Canada
